description: The KNOWN static type an arithmetic or concatenation column carries, read off DESCRIBE VIEW: + and - answer max leading digits plus one carry over max scale, * adds both precisions and scales, / is driven by the dividend with six extra scale digits, precision saturates at 38, FLOAT is contagious, string and binary concatenation add lengths (a converted operand giving the full-width VARCHAR), a shifted DATE stays DATE while a DATE difference is a NUMBER(9,0) day count, unary sign adds no digit, and modulo keeps max(L1,L2,2) leading digits over max scale. All live-measured. Converted 1:1 from expressions/BinaryOperationStaticTypeTest (now retired).
